jobs.title: Java Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: A Java Full Stack Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining both front-end and back-end components of web applications, ensuring seamless integration, scalability, and performance. Your future duties and responsibilities 1.Collaborate with product managers and business analysts to gather and analyse requirements, then translate them into technical specifications for both frontend and backend layers. 2.Design, develop and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices architecture using Java, Spring Boot or similar frameworks, ensuring modularity, scalability and maintainability. 3.Build responsive, interactive and highperforming user interfaces using frontend technologies such as React, Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS3, aligned with UX/UI designs. Architect and implement database models, data access layers and queries (SQL, NoSQL) supporting application backend and analytics needs, including optimization for largevolume data. 4.Integrate backend services with frontend interfaces, thirdparty APIs, external systems, and message/eventdriven pipelines (e.g., Kafka, MQ) to enable endtoend functional flows. 5.Participate in architecture discussions and define system design, modules, integration patterns, security, performance and scalability requirements. 6.Develop and maintain code following best practices: clean architecture, design patterns, refactoring, automated testing (unit, integration, endtoend) and continuous delivery. 7.Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, version control workflows (Git), build automation (Maven/Gradle), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and deployment automation. Optimize application performance: reduce response times, improve concurrency, manage memory, tuning and monitoring with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). 8.Troubleshoot production issues: diagnose root causes, debug across stack (UI to DB), coordinate with operations/support teams, implement fixes and document solutions. Ensure application security, data protection, compliance and rolebased access control, implementing authentication/authorization, encryption, secure coding practices. 9.Lead code reviews, mentor junior developers, share best practices and promote a culture of continuous improvement and high code quality. 10.Maintain documentation of system architecture, API contracts, deployment procedures, user guides and technical runbooks to support maintainability and handover. Participate in agile development ceremonies (sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, demos and retrospectives) ensuring fullstack deliverables align with sprint goals. 11.Work with QA and test automation teams to define test strategies, support TDD/BDD practices and ensure code quality across frontend and backend. Required qualifications to be successful in this role Must have skill FrontEnd : Angular/React, TypeScript Backend : Java Spring Boot, Spring Xecurity, Java 8, Maven Database : MongoDB (SQL) Good to have skill Cloud : Azure and/or AWS 5-9 Yrs Spring, Full Stack, Angularjs, Fullstack Development, Boot, Spring Boot, React.js, Bootstrap

It is a business-oriented language derived from BASIC and is commonly found in enterprise ERP, logistics, retail, manufacturing, and distribution applications. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Role & responsibilities Build RAG pipelines and LLM applications on self-hosted open-weight models. Deploy and optimize model inference (quantization, batching, GPU utilization) using vLLM, Ollama or similar tools. Design chunking, embedding and retrieval strategies using self-hosted vector databases. Build evaluation pipelines to measure retrieval and answer quality and to reduce hallucinations. Develop APIs (FastAPI or similar) that integrate AI services into enterprise applications. Containerize and deploy solutions in on-premise and air-gapped environments. Fine-tune or adapt models (LoRA/PEFT) where needed. Process structured and unstructured data, including document parsing and OCR. Collaborate with product managers, developers and clients to translate business requirements into working solutions. Keep up with developments in open-weight models, inference tooling and Generative AI Required Skills Strong Python, with experience in FastAPI or Flask, REST APIs and async programming. Hands-on experience with open-weight LLMs (Llama, Mistral, Qwen or similar) and Hugging Face Transformers. Experience building RAG systems using LangChain, LlamaIndex or custom pipelines. Experience with at least one self-hosted vector database (Qdrant, Milvus, Weaviate, pgvector, FAISS or ChromaDB). Experience serving LLMs locally (vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp or TGI). Prompt engineering and LLM evaluation methods. Working knowledge of Docker, Linux and Git. ML and NLP fundamentals (PyTorch preferred) SQL and database fundamentals Fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT). AI agents, tool calling and workflow automation. GPU deployment, CUDA basics and quantization formats (AWQ, GPTQ, GGUF). Observability and evaluation tools (Langfuse, Phoenix, RAGAS,Langsmith) Preferred candidate profile Experience with AI Agents and workflow automation. Knowledge of MLOps tools and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with Kubernetes is a plus. Familiarity with computer vision or speech processing is an added advantage. Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP): deploying containerized or GPU workloads, and familiarity with managed AI services (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI) for hybrid use cases Document AI/OCR, computer vision or speech processing. 2-5 Yrs Artificial Intelligence, GIT, Linux, Generation, Kubernetes, Performance, API, Engineering

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
jobs.description: Role Summary: HCLSoftware is seeking a Domain and Product Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join the Incubate Delivery function. This role sits within the build pool and is responsible for customising and configuring Incubate solutions to deliver the specific business outcomes each customer engagement requires. The Domain and Product FDE acts on behalf of the client. They take the requirements and detailed design produced by the Value Owner and Context and Data Strategist and turn them into working solutions inside the product, designing workflows, configuring orchestrations, building workbenches, and implementing process-led use cases using deep product fluency and domain understanding. This is not a core product development role. The Incubate product and solution teams own the architecture, engineering, and roadmap of the core products. This role makes those products work in the customers environment, configuring, extending, and customising them to deliver the outcomes the engagement has been designed to achieve. In traditional delivery, this would be recognised as a Product Specialist or Domain SME. In AIcentred delivery, the distinction matters more. Solutions built on AI, orchestration, and agentic capabilities need people who understand both the product and the business domain well enough to configure intelligently without defaulting to unnecessary custom development, and without losing sight of what the customer is actually trying to achieve. The role requires the judgement to know when to configure versus when to customise, when to use product capability as intended versus when to extend it, and when to push back on a requirement that would be better served by a different approach. That judgement comes from combining product knowledge with practical domain understanding. Role Scope in Practice Design, configure, and build customer-specific solutions within Incubate products, including workflows, orchestrations, workbenches, agents, and process-led use cases. Work from the documented requirements and detailed design produced by the Context and Data Strategist, translating specification into working product configuration. Apply domain understanding and product fluency to make informed configuration decisions that deliver the desired outcomes without unnecessary custom development. Collaborate with AI Orchestration and Engineering colleagues where solutions require integration, API connectivity, or technical build beyond product configuration. 2 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes Support the Quality and Compliance team by ensuring that what is built is testable, traceable, and aligned to the documented requirements and acceptance criteria. Participate in delivery calls and technical discussions where product and domain input is needed, without owning customer communication directly. Contribute to the reuse and maturity of solution patterns, configuration approaches, and domain-specific knowledge across engagements. Configure and maintain the behavioural controls that shape how AI agents operate within each customer's context, including prompt templates, agent personas, business guardrails, and escalation logic, ensuring agents behave in line with the process, the client's operating context, and the documented acceptance criteria. Key Responsibilities 1. Solution Configuration and Build Design and configure solutions within Incubate products to meet the specific requirements of each customer engagement. Build workflows, orchestrations, workbenches, agents, and process-led use cases using the product’s native capabilities and tooling. Make informed decisions about when to use standard product configuration, when to extend or customise, and when to escalate where a requirement may be better addressed through a different approach. Ensure that configured solutions are robust, maintainable, and aligned to the product’s intended architecture and design patterns. Work iteratively, delivering incremental capability that can be reviewed, validated, and refined through the engagement lifecycle. Design and configure prompt templates, agent personas, and behavioural parameters that control how AI agents interact with users, data, and business processes within each use case. Implement business guardrails and constraints that keep agent behaviour aligned to the customer's expectations, regulatory context, and risk appetite, including tone, scope boundaries, escalation triggers, and response limitations. 2. Domain Expertise and Product Fluency Bring practical understanding of the business domain to inform how solutions are designed and configured, ensuring they reflect how the customer’s processes, decisions, and workflows actually operate. Maintain deep fluency in Incubate product capabilities, tooling, and configuration options, staying current as products evolve. Use domain and product knowledge together to identify the most effective solution approach for each use case, avoiding over-engineering and unnecessary complexity. Advise the Context and Data Strategist and Value Owner where requirements may benefit from adjustment based on product capability or domain insight. Establish and maintain SME feedback loops working with customer subject matter experts to review agent behaviour, validate output quality, and iteratively refine prompt templates and behavioural configuration based on real-world performance. 3 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes 3. Working from Requirements and Detailed Design Take documented requirements and detailed design from the Context and Data Strategist as the primary input for build work. Seek clarification from the Context and Data Strategist where specifications are ambiguous, incomplete, or where product constraints create a gap between what is specified and what can be delivered. Ensure traceability between documented requirements and what is actually built, so that QA and validation activities have a clear baseline. Flag risks, constraints, and dependencies back to the delivery team early, particularly where product limitations or data readiness issues may affect the planned approach. 4. Collaboration and Delivery Integration Work as part of the integrated delivery team, collaborating closely with AI Orchestration and Engineering colleagues, the Context and Data Strategist, and the Quality and Compliance team. Participate in delivery ceremonies, technical discussions, and review sessions as needed. Support solution walkthroughs and demonstrations where product and domain expertise is required, without owning customer communication directly. Coordinate with other Domain and Product FDEs where multiple use cases or workstreams are running in parallel within an engagement. 5. Quality, Testing, and Handover Ensure that configured solutions are built to a standard that supports effective testing, validation, and acceptance. Support the Quality and Compliance team in validating that delivered solutions meet the documented requirements, acceptance criteria, and governance standards. Contribute to go-live readiness activities, including solution documentation, configuration records, and handover materials for the operate phase. Support operate-phase activities where ongoing configuration, refinement, or extension of solutions is required after initial go-live. 6. Knowledge Sharing and Reuse Contribute to the development of reusable solution patterns, configuration templates, and domain-specific knowledge across the function. Document configuration decisions, design rationale, and lessons learned so that knowledge is retained and transferable. Share product and domain expertise with colleagues across engagements, supporting the function’s ability to mobilise and deliver consistently. Required Experience Experience in a product configuration, solution delivery, or domain specialist role within enterprise software environments. Practical experience designing and building solutions using enterprise software products, configuring workflows, orchestrations, business rules, or process automation. 4 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes Demonstrable domain understanding in one or more relevant business areas, able to translate business processes and requirements into product configuration decisions. Experience working from documented requirements and detailed design, collaborating with business analysts or equivalent roles to clarify and refine specifications. Experience working as part of a multi-disciplinary delivery team, coordinating with engineering, QA, and advisory colleagues. Comfortable working iteratively, delivering incremental capability and adapting as requirements are refined through delivery. Skills and Capabilities Product fluency: able to work confidently within enterprise software products, using native tooling and configuration capabilities to build effective solutions. Domain understanding: brings practical knowledge of business processes, operational workflows, and industry context that informs how solutions are designed and configured. Configuration judgement: knows when to use standard configuration, when to extend, and when to push back, including the judgement to shape agent behaviour through prompt design and guardrails rather than defaulting to custom development. Analytical thinking: able to interpret requirements, identify gaps or ambiguities, and translate specification into working solutions. Collaboration: works effectively as part of an integrated team, particularly alongside Context and Data Strategists, AI Orchestration engineers, and QA colleagues. Communication: able to articulate technical decisions, constraints, and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues. Attention to detail: builds solutions that are robust, traceable, and aligned to documented requirements. Desirable Experience Experience with HCLSoftware products or comparable enterprise software platforms. Experience in AI, automation, orchestration, or agentic workflow delivery, understanding how product configuration differs when AI is at the centre of the solution. Experience with process mining, process mapping, or operational analytics tools. Familiarity with integration patterns, APIs, and data connectivity in the context of enterprise solution delivery. Experience in environments where governance, compliance, and auditability are embedded in the delivery process. Experience supporting operate-phase activities: extending, optimising, and refining solutions after initial go-live. Experience configuring or managing AI agents, conversational AI, or LLM-based solutions, including prompt engineering, behavioural tuning, and agent persona design. 5 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes Success Measures Months 1 to 3: Embedded and Building Integrated into active engagements and building solutions productively within Incubate products. Working effectively from documented requirements, with minimal rework caused by misinterpretation of specifications. Demonstrating product fluency and domain understanding that inform sound configuration decisions. Collaborating well with Context and Data Strategists, AI Orchestration colleagues, and the Quality and Compliance team. Months 3 to 6: Quality and Consistency Configured solutions consistently meet documented requirements and acceptance criteria, with minimal defects or rework at validation. Configuration decisions reflect good judgement: using product capability effectively, avoiding unnecessary custom development, and escalating appropriately where product constraints arise. Positive feedback from the delivery team on the quality, reliability, and maintainability of built solutions. Contributing to solution documentation and configuration records that support operatephase handover. Months 6 to 12: Depth and Reuse Recognised as a reliable, high-quality contributor to solution build across Incubate engagements. Contributing reusable solution patterns, configuration templates, and domain-specific knowledge to the function. Building depth of product and domain expertise that supports more complex use cases and engagement scenarios. Supporting the mobilisation of new engagements with established patterns and lessons from prior work. Candidate Profile Technically capable and product-oriented, with a genuine interest in how enterprise software solves business problems. Pragmatic and outcome-focused, builds solutions that work for the customer, not just solutions that are technically elegant. Comfortable working from documented requirements and collaborating closely with advisory and QA colleagues. Good judgement on when to configure, when to customise, and when to push back. Curious about the business domain, not just the product, wants to understand why something is being built, not just how. 6 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes Reliable, thorough, and motivated by delivering quality work that others can build on. Eager to learn, develop product depth, and grow domain expertise over time. 8-12 Yrs SQL, Integration, Microsoft, Rest, Continuous Integration, Machine learning, Continuous Integration, AWS

Write high-quality code, perform reviews, mentor staff, and support UX design. Architect Knowledge Graph schemas and property graph systems. Optimize query performance to minimize agent latency. Manage entity resolution , lineage tracking, and context assembly. Flexibility: Displays a strong desire to stay current by rapidly integrating the latest technological advancements into their work. Comprehensive Health: Benefit from an all-inclusive health insurance plan. Performance Recognition: Celebrate success with monthly "Star Employee" honors, performance bonuses, and various corporate gifts. Ongoing Education: Stay sharp with company-sponsored professional certification programs. Rapid Career Progression: As a foundational member of a growing GenAI team, your professional development will outpace traditional firms, offering three years of experience in just one. Advanced AI Toolkit: Maximize your efficiency with fully subsidized access to leading premium AI platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot. Remote-First Culture: Enjoy the flexibility to work from any location in India, focusing on results rather than rigid hours. We facilitate optional in-person meetups at a central location to foster team synergy. Founder Collaboration: Avoid bureaucracy by working directly with founders on frameworks and major global projects. If you are a driven engineer with a deep interest in software engineering and Agentic AI, we invite you to apply. Join our early-stage startup, where we prize innovation and creativity, and help us redefine the future of insights discovery and knowledge management. How to Apply: Please submit your resume & LinkedIn profile explaining why you are a great fit for this position, careers@elastiq.ai 5-8 Yrs SQL, Senior, Query Optimization, Fullstack Development, Docker, AWS, Microsoft Azure, System design

jobs.description: A bit about us WeatherBug is a popular weather site and mobile app providing hyperlocal, live weather data and proactive alerting to consumer users. With over 15 million unique users per month, across all platforms, WeatherBug's vision is to provide environmental intelligence for all aspects of people's lives. The WeatherBug app is a top-rated weather app in the app stores. In 2019, WeatherBug was named the best weather app by MediaPost's Appy Awards. WeatherBug is owned and operated by GroundTruth, a media company that turns real-world behavior into marketing that delivers real business results. Learn more at WeatherBug.com At GroundTruth, we believe that innovative technology starts with the best talent and we have been ranked one of Ad Age's Best Places to Work for three years in a row (2021, 2022 & 2023). **This role requires Core Work Hours from 8:30 pm to 12:30 am IST (will change as per daylight saving in US). The remaining hours are completed at individual discretion.** A bit about you We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer who can take a problem, not just a ticket, and carry it all the way to a working solution in production. You'll own major parts of the WeatherBug iOS app such as forecasts, severe weather alerts, radar maps, widgets or our ad integrations, and you'll be the person the team goes to for help in those areas. You'll join the iOS team and report to the Engineering Manager, iOS. You'll also mentor the associate and mid level engineers on the team. You will: - Design and build complete features in Swift, from the technical design through release, and fix issues in your areas before users notice them. - Write the design docs and diagrams for the parts of the app you own, and review the documentation others write. - Act as a CODEOWNER for your areas and give code reviews that improve quality, stability and maintainability. - Break large features into tasks, estimate them with product and QA, and keep the status of your work up to date. - Automate unit, integration and UI tests and connect them with our CI pipeline and the QA team's workflow. - Run and monitor App Store releases, including TestFlight builds, phased rollouts and checking crash and performance data after launch. - Work with third party SDK vendors for ads, analytics and crash reporting to keep their integrations healthy and get issues fixed when they break. - Help maintain the debugging and developer tools the team depends on. - Support your code and everything in your area in production, and take a full front line spot in the on call rotation. - Spot problems across the iOS codebase early and stop them from turning into incidents. - Remove old features, flags, SDKs and code once theyre no longer needed. - Coordinate with product, design, QA, backend and ad operations teams to work through technical risks and agree on solutions. - Mentor engineers on the team in both technical and soft skills. - Pick up new frameworks and tools quickly and teach them to the rest of the team. - Perform other job related duties as assigned. What success looks like in your first 6 months: - You own at least one major area of the iOS app and you're its CODEOWNER. - You've led a feature from design doc to release. - You're running releases on your own and taking regular on call shifts. - Something in your area is measurably better, such as crash rate, test coverage or build time. - At least one engineer on the team sees you as their go to mentor. You have: This is our ideal wish list, but most people don't check every box on every job description. If you meet most of the criteria below and you're excited about the opportunity and willing to learn, we'd love to hear from you. - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field with 7+ years of software development experience, OR 9+ years of professional software development experience without a degree. - 5+ years building and shipping iOS apps in Swift. - Working knowledge of Objective-C and experience maintaining and migrating older code. - Strong experience with UIKit, SwiftUI, Swift concurrency (async/await, actors) and Combine, and good judgement on when to use each. - Experience with architecture patterns such as MVVM or Clean Architecture, and with breaking a large app into modules. - Hands on experience with Core Location, push notifications (APNs), background tasks and WidgetKit. - Experience with feature flags, remote config, A/B testing and analytics events. - Experience building apps that work well on poor networks and offline, with sensible caching. - A good understanding of mobile security basics such as secure storage (Keychain), safe network calls and protecting user data. - Experience with XCTest and XCUITest, and with finding memory, CPU, battery and launch time problems using Instruments. - Experience with Swift Package Manager, Xcode build settings, code signing and mobile CI/CD using GitHub, Jenkins and tools like Fastlane. - Enough Kotlin or Java to read Android code and work with the Android team on shared features. - The ability to troubleshoot complex issues, including reading symbolicated crash logs and tracing problems across the app and its APIs. - Clear written and verbal communication with people inside and outside engineering. Would be great if you have: - Experience with mobile ad SDKs such as Google Mobile Ads, Google Ad Manager or Prebid. - You have regular use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code or the Xcode coding assistant for writing code, tests and refactors, with a habit of carefully reviewing what they produce. - Experience building on-device AI features with Core ML, Create ML or Apple's Foundation Models framework. - Experience using AI to speed up crash triage, test generation or code reviews. - Experience with App Tracking Transparency, privacy manifests and consent management (IAB TCF, GPP). - Experience working with large weather or geospatial datasets, map tiles or radar imagery. - Experience with Live Activities, App Intents or watchOS. - Accessibility experience with VoiceOver and Dynamic Type. - Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python or shell scripting. - Experience with Spinnaker or Artifactory. You are: - A team player who is organized, flexible and willing to adapt - Not afraid of new technologies and driven to learn - Detail oriented, someone who catches problems early and adjusts - A strong communicator who can work with business and engineering stakeholders and work through conflicting needs - A problem solver who likes to dig into a problem, find the root cause and work with other teams to fix it - Organized, with a proven ability to prioritize and deliver on time - Happy to roll up your sleeves and help when needed - Self sufficient and comfortable taking the lead and managing tasks on your own - Coachable and open to feedback - Respectful. We treat each other with respect and assume the best of one another - Not afraid to have fun! Good to know: - This role is remote within India and includes a few hours of overlap with our US teams on working days. - You'll be part of our on call rotation, which is shared across the team. - Our interview process includes a recruiter call, technical interviews and a final round with the hiring manager and team. - We use our Engineering Progression framework for feedback, growth and promotions, and we're happy to walk you through it during interviews. What we offer At GroundTruth, we want our employees to be comfortable with their benefits so they can focus on doing the work they love. - Parental leave (maternity and paternity) - Flexible Time Offs (Earned Leaves, Sick Leaves, Birthday leave, Bereavement leave & Company Holidays) - In Office Daily Catered Lunch - Fully stocked snacks/beverages - Health cover for any hospitalization. Covers both nuclear family and parents - Covid home quarantine cover - Tele-med for free doctor consultation, discounts on health checkups and medicines - Wellness/Gym Reimbursement - Pet Expense Reimbursement - Childcare Expenses and reimbursements - Employee assistance program - Employee referral program - Education reimbursement program - Skill development program - Cell phone reimbursement (Mobile Subsidy program) - Internet reimbursement - Employee Provident Fund Scheme offering different tax saving options such as VPF and employee and employer contribution up to 12% Basic - Creche reimbursement - Co-working space reimbursement - NPS employer match - Meal card for tax benefit - Special benefits on salary account - New joiner relocation 5-7 Yrs IOS, Software, LLD, Low Level Design, UI, Swift, Level Design, Io

jobs.title: Data Science Associate
jobs.description: ZS Advanced Data Science - Associate ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on transforming global healthcare and beyond, our most valuable asset is our people. Here youll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping solutions from start to finish. At ZS, we believe that making an impact demands a different approach; and thats why here your ideas elevate actions, and here youll have the freedom to define your own path and pursue cutting-edge work. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business including portfolio strategy, customer insights, research and development, operational and technology transformation, marketing strategy and many more. If you dare to think differently, join us, and find a path where your passion can change lives. Our most valuable asset is our people . At ZS we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences and belief systems the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are part of your success here. Learn more about our diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces, obtaining the resources they need to thrive, and sharing the messages they are passionate about. About Advanced Data Science (ADS): ZS Advanced Data Science group is focused on creating practical impact for clients across various industries such as Healthcare and Bio-Tech, Hi-Tech & Telecommunication, Financial Services and Travel through advanced analytics and emerging data sources. Emerging datasets include both unstructured datasets (for example, text, voice, image, etc.) and semi-structured datasets (for example, patient-level records). Advanced analytical techniques span a range of innovative machine learning, artificial intelligence, advanced statistics and optimization approaches. Being part of the ADS group at ZS will be an opportunity for you to work on cutting-edge solutions, utilizing new age data sources to shape innovations across multiple areas, for our clients and the broader ZS community. A key enabler of our services is leveraging data in delivering client solutions. The data available about customers is getting richer and the problems that our customers are trying to answer continue to evolve. In our endeavor to stay ahead in providing solutions to these evolving complex problems, ZS has set up an Advanced Data Science which has three major focus areas: • Research the evolving datasets and advanced analytical techniques to develop new offerings/solutions • Deliver client impact by collaboratively implementing these solutions • Provide thought leadership by developing the ZS Point of View in this space Data Science Associate Data Science Associate (DSA) design, develop and execute high-impact analytics solutions for large, complex, structured and unstructured data sets (including big data) to help clients make better fact-based decisions. Responsibilities: Develop advanced algorithms that solve problems of large dimensionality in a computationally efficient and statistically effective manner • Execute statistical and data mining techniques (e.g. hypothesis testing, machine learning and retrieval processes) on large data sets to identify trends, figures and other relevant information • Collaborate with clients and other ZS stakeholders to effectively integrate and communicate analysis findings • Contribute to the evaluation of emerging datasets and technologies that may contribute to our analytical platform • Evaluating emerging datasets and technologies that may contribute to our analytical platform • Owning the development of select assets/accelerators for efficient scaling of capability, with a focus on leveraging generative AI and deep learning methodologies. • Integrate engineering principles into data science workflows, optimizing algorithms for performance, scalability, and maintainability. • Collaborate with the engineering team to implement and deploy data science solutions into production, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems. • Utilize software engineering best practices for version control, code review, testing, and documentation to maintain high-quality, reliable, and reproducible data science workflows. jobs.title: ML Developer
jobs.description: About the Role We are looking for an ML Developer with 6+ years of experience to design, build, and deploy machine learning solutions supporting the surveillance function within a financial services environment. You will apply advanced ML techniques anomaly detection, NLP, behavioural analytics, and classification models — to enhance communication and trade surveillance capabilities, helping detect market abuse, misconduct, and compliance breaches at scale. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and deploy ML models for surveillance use cases — anomaly detection, behavioural analytics, NLP-based communication analysis, and pattern recognition across large-scale financial data. Build and maintain NLP pipelines — text classification, sentiment analysis, entity recognition, and semantic similarity — for electronic communication surveillance. Develop and maintain feature engineering pipelines — extracting, transforming, and selecting relevant features from trade, communication, and market data for ML model training. Train, evaluate, and optimise ML models — applying supervised, unsupervised, and semi-supervised learning techniques for surveillance detection and alert prioritisation. Integrate ML models into surveillance platforms — deploying models as REST APIs or batch inference pipelines for production consumption. Implement model monitoring and drift detection — ensuring surveillance models maintain accuracy, reliability, and performance in production. Collaborate with surveillance analysts, compliance teams, and data engineers — translating surveillance business requirements into well-designed ML solutions. Support alert tuning and false positive reduction — applying ML-driven approaches to improve surveillance detection quality and operational efficiency. Produce clear technical documentation — model design documents, feature specifications, and deployment runbooks. What We're Looking For 6+ years of ML development experience with strong Python and machine learning expertise in production environments. Strong ML skills — supervised, unsupervised, and semi-supervised learning — applied to anomaly detection, classification, and behavioural analytics use cases. Proven NLP expertise — text classification, sentiment analysis, named entity recognition, and semantic search using spaCy, NLTK, Hugging Face, or equivalent. Strong Python proficiency — NumPy, pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch — for ML model development and data processing. Experience with feature engineering — extracting and transforming features from structured and unstructured financial data for ML model training. Hands-on ML model deployment experience — REST API serving, batch inference, and containerised model deployment using Docker. Experience with MLflow or equivalent — experiment tracking, model versioning, and model registry management. Solid SQL skills — data querying and validation across large-scale financial datasets. Good understanding of financial services compliance or surveillance domain — communication surveillance, trade surveillance, or market abuse detection. Strong AWS experience — SageMaker, S3, Lambda, or equivalent — for ML model training and deployment. Excellent communication skills — presenting ML findings, model performance, and surveillance insights to compliance and technology stakeholders. Nice to Have Experience with LLMs and GenAI — GPT, Claude, or Llama — for advanced communication surveillance and intelligent alert summarisation. Familiarity with surveillance platforms — NICE Actimize, Behavox, or equivalent — and their ML integration patterns. Knowledge of graph-based ML — network analysis and entity relationship modelling for market abuse detection. Exposure to real-time streaming ML — Kafka or AWS Kinesis — for real-time surveillance alert generation. Experience with explainability frameworks — SHAP, LIME — for model transparency and regulatory audit support. Knowledge of regulatory frameworks — MiFID II, MAR, ASIC Market Integrity Rules — and their surveillance implications. AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty certification. Experience in Financial Services, Banking, or regulated industry environments. 7-12 Yrs Machine learning, Machine, Ml, Numpy, Python, Development, Pandas

Expose Amtech capabilities as MCP-described tools so any AI model can call them. Orchestration and Agent Execution Build and maintain the LLM orchestration layer that turns model output into safe, governed, tool-using actions. Implement and extend agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Retrieval and Model Integration Build and tune RAG pipelines for grounding agent responses in Amtech's own data. Integrate model-agnostic LLM providers — Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, and whatever model leads next — via a common provider abstraction, avoiding vendor lock-in. Governed On-Prem Data Access (the Data Agent) Build and maintain the Data Agent — new technology that reads EnCore and other customer data directly for inferencing, with no dependency on legacy point-to-point APIs. Ensure every agent action passes governed approval gates before it executes, with a complete, queryable audit trail — customer data stays in the customer's environment while still enabling cloud-LLM reasoning over it. Building Amtech AI Intelligence Capabilities Extend the platform into concrete delivered capabilities such as Schedule Intelligence (watching schedules, flagging conflicts and trim-loss, proposing re-sequencing), Order & Customer Intelligence (full-context status across specs, history, and dates), Docs & Knowledge (cited, grounded answers with stale-document detection), and Forecast & KPI Intelligence (plain-language questions over throughput, waste, and OTIF). Plugging Into Amtech's Broader Agent Portfolio Amtech already runs 10+ active agents company-wide — this role's platform work is what lets patterns from those efforts be reused instead of rebuilt. Directly support the Utilization mandate to extend engineering's agent-building cadence to Sales, Support, and Customer Success, so new agents in those functions can be built on the same governed orchestration, RAG, and audit foundation rather than one-off tooling. Scaling the Platform Pattern Across Product Lines Turn Amtech's first production agent pattern into a reusable platform component that other product pods can adopt without a rebuild. Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers embedded in product pods to validate the platform against real workflows and feed field learnings back into the roadmap. Deployment, Monitoring, and Cost Control Deploy agents and inference endpoints on AWS (e.g., Lambda, ECS/EKS, SageMaker) and integrate them into existing APIs and microservices. Set up evals, cost controls, and basic observability to catch regressions, drift, or runaway spend before they reach customers. Bridging into ML Engineering and MLOps Bring enough classical ML engineering and MLOps fluency (feature stores, model registries, CI/CD for models, drift monitoring) to partner effectively with the Data Science, ML Engineering, and MLOps functions, not just the agentic/LLM side of the platform. As a senior technical voice on the team, weigh in on production practices — deployment, monitoring, retraining — across both agentic and classical ML workloads as the org scales toward a lead role. Required Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or related field. 6+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years hands-on building production systems with large language models. Demonstrated experience setting technical direction and reviewing the work of other engineers, even if not a formal people-management role. Strong Python programming skills. Practical experience with prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph). Experience integrating at least one major LLM provider API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or AWS Bedrock). Hands-on AWS experience (e.g., Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) deploying and operating production workloads in the cloud. Experience with model inferencing — real-time and batch — including optimizing latency, throughput, and cost for LLM or ML workloads. Experience building or consuming RAG pipelines and working with vector databases. Working knowledge of classical ML engineering and MLOps practices (e.g., feature stores, model registries, MLflow/Kubeflow-style CI/CD for models) — enough to partner with Data Science, ML Engineering, and MLOps, not necessarily hands-on ownership. Familiarity with Docker and containerized deployment. Working knowledge of Git and CI/CD practices. Preferred Qualifications Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar agent-tool integration standards. Experience building governed, read-only data access layers (audit logging, guardrails, least-privilege access). Exposure to Kubernetes and cloud AI/inferencing platforms (AWS Bedrock, AWS SageMaker); AWS certification is a plus, not a requirement. Experience working with ERP, MES, or other industrial/manufacturing data environments. Prior experience embedding directly with a product team or customer-facing engineering effort. Familiarity with performance monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog). Why Join Amtech At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista. 6-11 Yrs Events, Intelligence, Architecture, Computer vision, Tools, Vision, Machine learning, Python Framework
